prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: bundled sample photograph inside the OpenFilm browser photo editor. Primary request: Create a believable scenic photograph that is satisfying to color grade, crop, and adjust, with no people. Scene/backdrop: a quiet alpine lake at first light, dark rocky shoreline in the foreground, a ribbon of low mist above the water, layered pine-covered slopes, and distant pale mountains with a small patch of snow. Subject: the scenery itself, with clear foreground, middle distance, and background depth. Style/medium: natural full-frame digital landscape photography with restrained 35mm film character, fine detail, subtle grain, and no synthetic gloss. Composition/framing: horizontal 3:2 frame, shoreline leading diagonally into the lake, open water reflecting the sky, balanced detail across the frame, enough room for square and portrait crops. Lighting/mood: soft early morning side light, recoverable highlights in the sky, open shadows in the rocks and trees, gentle atmosphere, broad tonal range without crushed blacks. Color palette: cool slate water, deep natural greens, neutral stone, a restrained warm peach glow near the horizon; balanced and not already heavily graded. Materials/textures: rippled water, rock, pine needles, mist, and distant snow should retain real texture. Constraints: no people, no animals, no buildings, no roads, no boats, no text, no logos, no watermark, no surreal elements. Avoid: postcard oversaturation, teal-orange color grade, HDR halos, impossible reflections, exaggerated sun rays, excessive bokeh, over-sharpening, painterly or obvious AI artifacts.
